summary: Analyzes how real TCP implementations handle the urgent mechanism and how middleboxes interfere with it. It updates RFC 793, RFC 1011 and RFC 1122 to match current practice and advises against relying on urgent data. It is a proposed standard that was replaced by RFC 9293.

eli5.summary: TCP has a way to flag a part of the data as urgent, like waving a flag in a queue. In practice people handle the flag differently, so this note says not to count on it.

questions: should applications use tcp urgent data
